input.relationship: src/checkout.ts#checkout call src/cart.ts#Cart.total (forward); src/cart.ts#Cart.total call src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount (forward)

evidence.reason: Body changed from price*(1-rate) to price-rate, breaking the documented/tested semantics (applyDiscount(100,0.1) expected 90, now 99.9).
Calls applyDiscount(amount, 0.1) and relies on multiplicative discount; with the new subtractive body the returned total is wrong.
Calls applyDiscount(price, 0.1); inherits the broken discount semantics.
Calls applyDiscount(price, 0.2); test expects 80 for 100 but now gets 99.8.
Adds +1 to cart.total(), compounding the pricing error and violating the checkout test expecting 'USD 18.00'.
assert.equal(applyDiscount(100,0.1),90) fails under the new subtractive implementation.

evidence.symbol: 结账使用购物车折后总价
季节规则与重导出报告使用折后价格
evidence.reason: assert.equal(new SeasonalRule().apply(100),80) fails under the new implementation.

result.userExplanation: 这两处改动共同破坏了折扣与结账的既有契约：applyDiscount 由乘法折扣改为减法，导致所有调用方与测试的预期金额全部错误，checkout 又额外加 1 进一步偏离预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请将 src/pricing.ts 中 applyDiscount 的函数体恢复为 price * (1 - rate)，并将 src/checkout.ts 中 checkout 的返回恢复为 formatMoney(cart.total())，不要保留 +1。
